upgrades.d: Flash freeze. Every 15th hit you land freezes every enemy within 3 m of the orb for 1.5 seconds.
Cornered animal. Orb damage climbs as your health falls, up to +80% at death's door.
Guarded. Your orb swats enemy projectiles out of the air, even at a standstill.
The ground remembers. Half a second after each direct hit, the spot detonates for 40% of the damage.

A guardian angel joins you. Its lances of light pierce every enemy in a line and judge them: judged enemies hit you 20% softer, and when one dies, a pillar of light smites everything around it. Grows with the waves.
Brighter light. Angel lance damage +7.
The verdict holds. Judgement lasts 1.5s longer.
Wrath from above. The Angel's smite hits +8 harder and reaches 0.3 m further.
No wind-up. Slap the orb back as it comes at you, or swing within a second of catching it, and it leaves +60% faster and +35% harder.
Hold the line. After standing still for half a second, you take 40% less damage until you move.
Blood frenzy. Each kill adds speed & damage. Stacks up to 8, lost on hit.
Event horizon. The orb drags everything within 3 m into itself and grinds what it catches. Each stack widens the pull by 1.1 m.
Wider ruin. Every explosion, pulse and shockwave your orb makes reaches 30% further.
Cuts that linger. Direct hits apply a bleed dealing 5 damage per second for 3s.
Trade up. Killing anything within 3s of being hurt restores 4 HP.
Paid in red. Kills drop double essence while you are below half health.
Signed in blood. Orb damage +50%, but you no longer heal between waves.
Paid in full. Orb damage +1% for every 1% of health you are missing, but all healing is halved.
Hunter's high. Each kill boosts your movement speed by 120 for 2 seconds.
Close company. While a companion is within 3 m of you, you take 10% less damage.
Comes back to you. Every throw returns on its own after 0.8s, and that counts as a recall -- but recalling by hand has a 30s cooldown.
Wanted, alive or dead. Elites drop double essence, and bosses half as much again.
Strike. Enemies your orb knocks back become projectiles. Slammed into scenery, one takes the hit again; slammed into another enemy, it deals that enemy the hit and takes it back with 50% more.
Stored spark. Each wall bounce stores a charge, up to 3. The orb's next enemy hit chains lightning to one more enemy per charge, for half the hit.
Trick shot. Every wall bounce charges the orb +15% damage, up to 5, spent on the next enemy hit.
Spend it. Recalling by hand cashes in your combo: the returning orb deals +2% for every point of combo, and the combo drops to half.
Arc discharge. Every hit chains lightning to up to 3 nearby foes. Take it again: +1 jump, +1.5 m reach and +5 arc damage.
Wind it up. Hold the throw to charge it through three levels, release to let it fly -- up to 2.1x launch force and 2.2x damage on the first thing it hits. It never fires on its own.
Numbing chill. Chilled and frozen enemies deal 25% less damage to you.
Go out with a bang. When a combo of 10 or more drops, it detonates around you -- harder the bigger it was.
Every 6th throw leaves burning: 2.5x damage and a crater where it lands.
Sign here. The next 3 waves come 30% tougher -- survive them and you are handed a free legendary.
Nothing left behind. Burning deals 50% more damage, but burning enemies never drop health.
Build it up. Every 10th hit of a combo detonates a free void ring around the orb.
Volatile energy. Orb critical hit chance +10% per stack.
Refined taste. Banished cards are replaced by an epic or legendary.
Shards of spite. Enemy kills shatter into 3 homing fragments each dealing 8 damage. Grows with the waves.
Bone-jarring catch. Stopping the orb with your body blasts nearby enemies, harder the faster it was going.
One perfect shot. The first enemy each throw hits takes a guaranteed critical hit at double damage. After that, the throw cannot crit.
Soul explosion. Each kill bursts into a wide void ring dealing 18 damage. Grows with the waves.
Room for more. Kills drop 20% more essence per stack.
A cursed imp binds to you. Its claws rip through whole groups and mark them to take 75% more damage from everything. Grows with the waves.
The mark festers longer. Curse duration +1.5s.
Serrated demonic claws. Demon hit damage +8.
Amplified hex. Cursed enemies take 10% more damage from all sources.
Sleep on it. The more essence you hold, the harder you hit -- up to +40% damage. Weighed against shop prices, so late-game riches count no more than early savings.
Brimming over. Every 12 kills' worth of essence you collect bursts out of you, hitting everything nearby for 45 damage. Grows with the waves.
Nothing escapes. Your Black Hole also drags enemy shots into itself and swallows them.
No mercy. A direct hit that would leave an enemy under 10% health kills it outright.
Nothing to carry. Move speed +40%, but max HP -15%.
Trail of embers. You leave a line of fire where you walk for 2s, and enemies that step in it catch fire.
A better hand. Gain 2 more rerolls right now.
Spalling. Wall bounces shed two cutting shards that fly off and carve anything they meet.
Chill to the bone. Hit an enemy twice in 3s to freeze them solid for 2s.
Cold shatter. A frozen enemy that dies bursts into an ice nova, damaging and chilling the rest.
Icy wake. Orb trail slows enemies by 65% while they stand in it.
Splinter. 10% of direct hits throw off a shard that strikes the nearest other enemy for 25% of the hit.
A mountain goat guards you. It charges anything that comes near you and rams it -- and everything beside it -- flying away. Grows with the waves.
Filed to a point. Goat ram damage +9.
Seeing stars. The goat's rams daze everything they hit for 0.5s (+0.5s a stack).
Never tires. The goat rams 25% more often.
Dense iron core. Bleeds speed faster, but +20 bonus damage on every hit.
Deep cuts. Each bleed stack on an enemy makes it take 2% more damage from everything, up to 10 stacks.
Cold touch. Every direct hit slows the enemy by 40% for 1.5 seconds.
Seeks warm flesh. Orb gently steers toward the nearest enemy.
Left behind. Each throw leaves a copy of the orb where you threw it for 2s, and anything that walks into it takes 30% of a hit.
Speed becomes power. A moving orb hits harder the faster it travels, with no upper limit -- every point of launch force you own finally counts.
Savings grow. Every shop you open pays 15% interest on the essence you walked in with.
Hardened body. Invincibility frames after being hit +0.06s.
Lucky strike. One kill in twenty pays its essence six times over.
Unstoppable. The orb no longer bounces off enemies -- it ploughs straight through them.
Fuel for the fire. Burning enemies take 25% more damage from the orb.
Force into armour. Every 6 orb hits you land build 8 points of shield.
Cornered. Below 30% health you take 35% less damage and deal 30% more.
Draining chill. Enemies standing in your frost trail slowly heal you for 0.5 HP/s.
Vampiric orb. Every enemy the orb kills restores 2 HP.
Hollow crystal core. Higher top speed and much faster acceleration.
Invisible tether. Orb slowly drifts back toward you when idle.
Distance is damage. Hits landed far from you deal +12% more per stack.
Keep the beat. You get 1.6s longer to land the next hit before the combo drops.
Rolling thunder. Orb damage +3% per point of combo, up to +60% at 20, lost when the combo drops.
Double up. A hit that kills adds 2 to the combo instead of 1.
Keep time. A hit landed in the last quarter of the combo timer deals double damage.
Sharpen your orb's impact. Orb damage +5 per hit.
Scorched earth. Orb leaves burning fire that deals 20 damage per second.
Grow the orb's mass. Size +20%, wider hitbox.
Explosive launch power. Orb launch force +100.
A shard circles you forever, striking anything it sweeps through. Weaker than your orb, but never stops.
More firepower. Another shard joins the ring.
Wider circle. Mirror Ball radius +0.6 m, covers more ground.
Dizzying spin. Mirror Ball rotation speed increases.
Build the charge. Every 5th consecutive enemy hit (no wall bounces) deals double damage.
Nothing wasted. Half of any healing above full HP becomes a shield instead of vanishing.
A storm familiar joins you. Calls down lightning every 1.3 seconds, and each bolt leaps on through two more foes. Grows with the waves.
Razor-sharp claws. Owl attack damage +11.
Relentless diver. Owl strikes 25% more often.
Keen eyes. Owl detects and attacks from 2.2 m further away.
Alpha. Every companion deals 20% more damage for each companion you have.
Spreading cold. A frozen enemy chills every enemy that touches it.
Mirror images. Two ghost orbs flank and mimic the main orb's path.
Spectral edge. The first enemy you hit each throw does not stop the orb -- it takes the hit and the orb carries straight on.
Pinned. A critical hit pins a non-boss enemy in place for 0.8s.
Pocketed. If the orb is within 2 m when you blink, it comes with you.
Brute force. Everything you hit is knocked back 25% harder and takes 10% more damage, per stack.
Funeral fire. A burning enemy that dies leaves a patch of fire for 2s that sets alight whatever walks in.
Blood in the air. Each kill makes you faster, stacking up to 10. Every hit you take costs 4 stacks.
They serve you now. 4% of the enemies you kill rise as allies and fight for you for 8 seconds.
Feeding frenzy. Each kill makes the orb 5% bigger and 4% stronger, up to 10. Shrinks back between kills.
Shield bash. Every 8 seconds, your next throw also sends out a shockwave that hurls nearby enemies back and stuns them for 1 second.
Slow mending. Recover 1 HP every 2.5 seconds, always, even mid-fight.
Held in reserve. Your F ability holds 2 charges, and the cooldown keeps refilling the second while the first is still ready.
Two notes, one chord. When both orbs strike the same enemy within 2s, the pair detonates for heavy damage.
Pain returned. Each hit you take stores a charge (up to 3); your next throw deals +40% per charge to the first enemy it hits.
Elastic bounce. Orb gains +100 speed every time it bounces off an enemy.
Cut through the veil. Enemies you pass through mid-blink take 25 damage. Grows with the waves.
On the run. Throwing while you run adds twice your running speed to the throw.
Torn space. Blinking detonates for 30 damage at both the place you left and the place you arrive. Grows with the waves.
Practised hands. Catching the orb makes you invulnerable for 0.6 seconds.
A second heart, beating out of time. Max HP +40, healed immediately.
Refuse to fall. A killing blow instead puts you back on 30 HP, untouchable for 3 seconds, and blasts the field. Recharges every 3 waves.
Predatory arc. After a direct hit the orb turns and flies at the next nearest enemy. +1 redirect per stack, up to 5.
Heavy landing. Hits faster than 12 m/s send out a shockwave that deals 60% of the hit to everything nearby.
Gone again. Killing an enemy within 1.5s of blinking refunds the blink.
Break the ice. Hitting a frozen enemy deals 30% more damage.
Play to the crowd. The orb flies 5% faster for every combo tier you reach.
Every second orb that returns to you fires straight back out at the nearest enemy with 50% more force.
Find the seam. Critical hits deal an extra 60% of the orb's damage, per stack.
Reaping. Every 8th enemy that dies leaves a soul that restores 6 HP.
Bound together. 35% of every hit echoes onto the nearest other enemy.
Money well spent. Everything you buy in the shop makes you stronger for the rest of the run: +2% damage a purchase, up to +24%.
Twin trajectory. Every throw splits in two; each half deals 60% damage, and they merge back when you catch or recall the orb.
Showstopper. Reaching a new combo tier stuns every enemy within 4 m of the orb for 0.6s.
Stored current. Each throw banks a charge, up to 5. Recalling fires one lightning bolt per charge at enemies near the orb; charges with no enemy to strike are kept.
Live wire. Enemies standing close to you take 6 damage twice a second.
Skin like the old rocks. All damage you take is reduced by 20%.
Thunder follows. The orb sheds a lightning bolt every 4 m it travels, striking the nearest enemy.
Live current. Chain Lightning arcs now stun everything they touch for 0.6s.
Eye of the storm. Every 4th hit calls lightning down on the target, arcing to 3 more enemies for 80% of the hit.
Time distortion. A fast-moving orb crawls nearby enemies to 15% speed and bleeds them while they are stuck.
Live wire. While recalling, the cord between you and the orb cuts and slows everything it crosses.
Spite. Anything that lands a hit on you takes 22 damage and is thrown off. Grows with the waves.
Sonic impact. Wall bounces release a shockwave that stuns nearby enemies for 1.2s.
Eye of calm. Stand still for 1s and lightning strikes the nearest enemy within 6 m every 1.5s.
The crowd pays up. Every combo tier you reach pays 2 essence for each tier you are on.
A cut of the ritual. Every third wave hands you one extra card choice.
Bank it. Each wall bounce before a throw's first enemy hit adds 10% crit chance to that hit, up to +50%.
Two of everything. A second orb joins you, and a single swing throws both.
Insatiable hunger. Life Steal heals +1 extra HP per kill per stack.
Close feeding. Anything that dies near you gives back 2 HP.
Faster pulsing. Void ring fires 0.2s sooner each stack.
Rhythmic void energy. Orb releases a damage ring every 1.2s.
Expanding void. Pulse ring radius +0.4 m on each release.
Delayed charge. The first enemy a recalled orb hits on its way back sets it off: 20 damage in a burst around it. Grows with the waves.
A shell of old magic. Absorbs one hit completely, then rebuilds itself over 25 seconds.
Sic 'em. Recalling sends every companion at the orb's last target at once. Once every 8s.
Blizzard. Every 10th enemy you freeze chills every enemy within 14 m for 2s.
Fortify your body. Max HP +10, healed immediately.
Light-footed magic. Move speed +20, dodge faster.
Swap. Blink while holding recall to trade places with the orb. Once every 6s.
Demolition. The orb doubles in size and damage, but flies and comes back 20% slower.

achievements.d: Clear a wave past wave 3 without being hit.
Clear 5 waves in a row without being hit.
Reach wave 10 without taking a single hit.
Take 20 upgrades in a single run.
Take 40 upgrades in a single run.
Have the owl and the demon at once.
Reach wave 10 without rerolling or banishing.
Survive 10 minutes in a single run.
Have four Mirror Ball shards orbiting at once.
Ghost through 50 enemies with Phase Shot.
Catch your orb 100 times in a single run.
Recall your orb 50 times in a single run.
Get blown up by a kamikaze skeleton.
Let one vampire drink from near death back to full health.
Die within 30 seconds of starting a run.
Die within 3 seconds of Second Wind saving you.
Clear a wave sitting on exactly 1 HP.
Get your orb 1500px away from you.
Kill at least one of every enemy type, bosses aside.
Redirect a single throw through 5 enemies.
Clear a wave without landing a single orb hit.
Nuke your orb while it is sitting in your hand.
Raise a Forcefield with no enemies anywhere near you.
Die while your Decoy is still out there running.
Rewind into less health than you started with.
Reroll the same hand 5 times in one wave.
Banish 10 cards in a single run.
Reach wave 8 having taken 5 upgrades or fewer.
Die on the exact wave you last died on.
Land a hit carrying a full five-bounce Carom charge.
Land an orb hit 1,000px away from yourself.
Plough through 6 enemies in one throw as a Juggernaut.
Deal 500 damage with a single orb hit.
Deal 2,000 damage with a single orb hit.
Drag 12 enemies into a single Singularity.
Clear a wave past wave 5 in under 20 seconds.
Call down a Meteor with no enemies anywhere.
Recall an orb that is already in your hands.
Stand perfectly still for 45 seconds with enemies alive.
Get hit by three different enemies within two seconds.
Spend more than four minutes on a single wave.
Harvest a soul while already on full health.
Clear a wave under every modifier.
Clear a Blood Moon wave without being hit.
Get killed by an enemy you had already killed.
Reach wave 10 without taking a single upgrade.
Reach wave 50 without taking a single upgrade.
Reach wave 100 without taking a single upgrade.
Kill a boss without being hit that wave.
Kill The Collector and take your cards back.
Kill two different bosses in a single run.
Clear every kind of special wave.
Clear a Siege without being hit.
Punch through a bulwark's shield with raw speed.

abilities.d: Raise a dome nothing can enter. Enemies inside are shoved out, and none can follow, for 6 seconds.
Detonate your orb: 220 damage in a huge radius plus massive knockback, growing with the wave. The orb reforms after 5 seconds.
Send out a double that sprints away. Enemies chase it instead of you for 6 seconds.
Crawl the world to a quarter speed for 5 seconds. You are unaffected.
Your orb swells into a comet for 10 seconds: triple size, 3.6x damage, and it ploughs straight through enemies AND scenery.
Snap back to where you stood 3 seconds ago, restore the health you had then plus 15%, and leave a time-quake where you were: 60 damage, growing with the wave, and a 1.5 second stun.
Call down a meteor on the largest group of enemies. 195 damage in a wide crater, growing with the wave, one second after the sky opens.
Plant a crystal sentry that fires on the nearest enemy for 12 seconds, twice a second, hitting for 28 a shot and growing with the wave.
Tear a hole in the world. Everything nearby is dragged in for 3 seconds, then it collapses for 140 damage, growing with the wave.
Call a storm. For 5 seconds, lightning hammers the crowd three times a second -- 34 to what it hits and 15 to everything beside it, growing with the wave.
Freeze every enemy on screen solid for 4 seconds. They cannot move, attack or detonate.
Brace. Gain 60 shield and take half damage for 8 seconds.

modifiers.d: The horde is faster and hits harder. Kills are worth more.
Far more of them, far more fragile, and they arrive fast.
Thick-skinned and slow. Bring something that hits hard.
Every single one wears a crown. There are fewer of them.
Everything you kill explodes. Mind where you are standing.
They hit harder, but every kill pays double.
Everything here breeds. Kill them somewhere with room.
They come in a constant stream and never stop arriving.

compositions.d: Armour, and plenty of it. Few, slow, and very hard to move.
All of it is airborne, all of it shoots, and none of it will come to you.
Everything here is faster than you and none of it stops.
They are keeping each other alive. Decide what dies first.
Everything on this wave either explodes or divides. Mind where you stand.
Nothing but casters. Every one of them is reaching for your feet.

difficulties.d: Weaker foes, room to breathe, and a deeper bag of rerolls.
The ritual as it was written. The intended fight.
They come faster, hit harder, and the wave's respite is thin.
Deadlier foes, bosses sooner, and the good cards hide.
difficulties.tag: For a build that has to be earned.

families.d: The orb itself: its speed, size, bounces, throws and catches.

boosts.d: Your recall pulls the orb home 25% faster.
Your orb knocks enemies back 30% further.
Orb hits and Kinetic cards deal +20% damage.

traits.d: Throws leave 20% faster.
A blink that ends within 3 m of the orb catches it.
The orb loses speed half as fast in flight, and an orb that slows to a crawl away from you glides back on its own.

families.d: Crits, long shots and executions: every hit chosen.

boosts.d: The first direct hit of a throw that has bounced fewer than 2 times, while the orb is still moving fast, snaps the orb back to you four times as fast as a recall. It counts as one.
Critical hits deal 30% more damage.
+20% critical hit chance.

traits.d: Hits 6 m or more from where you threw get +10% crit chance.
A critical hit sprays out behind the enemy: everything in a 3 m cone past it takes half the hit.
Every hit marks an enemy for 5s. A direct hit on a marked enemy, before the throw has bounced off any enemy, deals 2.5x damage.

boosts.d: Your burns last 3 seconds longer.
Burning enemies take +15% damage from everything.
Fire cards deal +20% damage.

traits.d: Every burn lasts 2s longer.
An orb hit on a burning enemy sets off the rest of its burn at once, then sets it burning again.
When a burning enemy dies, everything within 3 m catches fire, and can spread it again.

families.d: Chills, freezes, and what shatters afterwards.

boosts.d: Slowed enemies move 20% slower still.
A frozen enemy below 15% health shatters and dies outright. Bosses excepted.
Frozen or slowed enemies take +15% damage from everything.

traits.d: Your chills last 2s longer.
The orb loses no speed bouncing off frozen enemies.
A frozen enemy that dies bursts into an ice nova that freezes everything near it, so it chains through a frozen crowd.

families.d: Lightning that arcs from one body to the next.

boosts.d: Lightning and void pulses charge what they hit for 3 seconds: your orb deals 25% more damage to a charged enemy.
Storm attacks chain to one more enemy: Chain Lightning jumps once more, and every other Storm hit arcs to the nearest enemy within 2.6 m for half its damage.
A hit that takes 15% of an enemy's health calls down a bolt that stuns it for 1 second. Once every 3 seconds per enemy.

traits.d: Every lightning chain jumps 1 m farther.
An enemy killed by lightning passes it on: the chain jumps from the body to up to 3 more enemies.
Chain Lightning jumps to the lowest-health enemies within 6 m, and kills any it leaves under 10% health.

families.d: Gravity, time, pulses, and stepping through space.

boosts.d: A recalled orb hauls every enemy it passes along behind it.
Blink recharges 1 second sooner.
Void damage slows enemies by 40% for 1 second.

traits.d: Blinking tugs enemies within 2 m of where you left 1 m inward.
An orb at rest slowly pulls enemies within 3 m toward it.
Your blink leaves a rift where you started. Blink back to it before it fades and everything within 5 m collapses into it for 200% orb damage.

families.d: Echoes and copies: mirror shards, phantoms, links.

boosts.d: Arcane cards deal +15% damage.
Direct hits have a 10% chance to echo, striking every other enemy within 2 m for the same damage.
Direct hits have a 10% chance to land twice.

traits.d: Arcane cards (echoes, copies and shards) deal 15% more damage.
When the orb kills, a phantom of it leaps from the body to the nearest enemy for 40% of the hit.
A ghost orb follows your orb's path 5s behind it, passing through enemies for half damage.

families.d: Kills, bleeding, and power drawn from your own wounds.

boosts.d: Healing from Blood cards is 50% stronger.
Hits on enemies below half health deal +20% damage.
Kills leave a pool of blood for 3 seconds. Enemies in it are slowed by 40%.

traits.d: Every kill gives you a burst of speed for 2s.
Enemies that die bleeding spread their bleed to the 4 nearest within 2 m.
An orb hit on a bleeding enemy deals its remaining bleed three times over at once, then bleeds the 2 nearest enemies within 4 m.

boosts.d: Companions attack 20% faster.
Companions deal 25% more damage.
Companions see and reach 25% further.

traits.d: Companions move 15% faster.
Companions go for whatever your orb hit last.

Every companion gains a power. Owl: its bolts hit everything within 1.5 m, and every 4th stuns. Demon: an enemy dying within 4s of its claws bursts into flame. Angel: heals you 1 HP every 3s. Goat: Stampede, 30% faster and harder rams that shove further and carry on in a cone behind the target.

boosts.d: Every max-health card you own gives 10 more max health.
A small shield slowly circles you, covering a tenth of the way round. Shots and blows that meet it are stopped.
Your shield no longer drains away while you go unhit.

traits.d: A 15-point shield that comes back after 4s without being hit.
A hit your Ward or Spinning Guard stops stuns the attacker for 0.5s.
Taking damage sets off a 4 m nova for 200% orb damage that stuns for 1s. Once every 5s.

families.d: Cards that feed on, or pay out, the combo meter.

boosts.d: +5% damage for every 25 combo, up to +25%.
While your combo is above 50, you earn 1 essence every 2 seconds.
Lose a GODLIKE combo and your next hit brings it all back. Once, then it recharges when a combo drops for good.

traits.d: Your combo window is 1s longer.
Hits 5, 15, 25 ... of a combo send out a free void ring.
When a combo of 10 or more would drop, it falls to half instead (once a streak), and the lost half flies as a combo bomb at the biggest crowd on screen. Bosses take a quarter.

families.d: The unaligned: speed, economy, and deals with a catch.

boosts.d: +25% essence from kills.
Everything in the shop costs 15% less.
Every chance on your Wild cards is 5% higher: Jackpot pays out one kill in ten.

traits.d: +8% walk speed.
Each Wild card also counts toward your leading family's traits.
Each wave you borrow the third tier of a random family you have not completed.
